text:
Silas: Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from today's all-hands. I promised a thread for hiring/org Qs about the reorg and headcount plan. Ask here and we'll answer live.

Maya: Thanks @Silas. I'll kick off — short version: no mass layoffs. We're reallocating ~12 FTEs from internal infra initiatives into product-facing squads over the next quarter.

Jordan: Quick clarifying Q: does reallocation mean positions are being cut and folks offered new roles, or are we hiring into the product squads?

Maya: Good Q. Both. About 8 people will shift roles (mostly infra -> platform integrations) and we will hire ~4 new heads to fill capacity gaps in ML infra and customer reliability.

Alex: And attrition? If we lose people during the transition does that change the plan?

Maya: We modeled 10% voluntary attrition. If more than that leaves in a short window, we may open additional reqs to keep timelines intact.

Leah: For recruiting timeline: we'll post internal transfers + role descriptions by EOD tomorrow. External postings for the 4 new reqs go live next week. Internal candidates encouraged.

Priya: From Eng leadership: this is about prioritizing customer-facing latency & rollout work. The product squads will own model rollouts, canary pipelines, and SLA improvements. Infra team keeps core runtime and cross-cutting reliability.

Jordan: Any headcount numbers we can share now? even a simple table would help managers plan.

Maya: Sure — high-level snapshot (approx):
```
Before: infra 28, product 42, research 18, ops 12
After: infra 20, product 50, research 18, ops 12
Net change: +8 product, -8 infra (realloc) +4 net hires planned
```

Tony: Finance note: we have budget to convert ~6 contractor roles to FTEs and fund the 4 hires this fiscal year under the strategic reorg bucket. This keeps burn within plan.

Alex: Will managers need to submit new role descriptions or is People drafting them?

Maya: People Ops will draft templates and work with hiring managers. We'll run a 2-week internal transfer window first. Templates + FAQ will be uploaded to the HR drive.

Leah: To be explicit on process: 1) internal candidates apply, 2) interviews are scoped shorter for transfers, 3) offers processed with one-week priority. We'll post details tomorrow.

Silas: Two leadership-level Qs I heard: will any teams be reporting to different directors, and is there a change to promotion/grading?

Priya: A handful of squads will move from Platform org into Product Delivery for tighter alignment. No wholesale manager reshuffle. Promotion criteria unchanged; comp bands remain the same. Any exceptions will be documented.

Jordan: If my engineer wants to opt out of a role change, what happens?

Maya: Opt-outs are allowed. We'll work with affected managers to find alternative roles or a transition plan. No one will be forced into a role they don't want.

Alex: Will this affect hiring for APAC locations? We're seeing demand there.

Leah: We still plan to hire across NA and EMEA this quarter; APAC will be opportunistic unless a priority bucket is approved. If you have candidate leads, flag them to me.

Silas: Appreciate the quick questions. We'll keep this thread open until Friday and post a follow-up doc with links to role templates, timeline, and FAQs. If you want a 1:1, ping @Maya or @Leah. :thumbsup:
